rulebookCompliance: USA Pickleball Official Rulebook 2026 & DUPR Rating System

shots.name: Cross-Court Dink (4 Variants)
shots.proCoachTip: Dylan Frazier: "Match your biomechanics to tactical intent: Lift (+20°/4h00) to reset, Push (+10°/3h20) for depth, Slice (+26°/3h45➔5h00) to pull wide, and Topspin (+4°/3h15➔2h45) brushing the back of the ball up to your shoulder."

shots.name: Third Shot Drop
shots.proCoachTip: Collin Johns: "Never scoop with a flat open face; use a +8° slightly open face (3h30) and +38° shoulder lift (3h30➔2h45) up to your shoulder for 1100 RPM topspin dropping into the kitchen."

shots.name: Third Shot Drive
shots.contactPoint: +42cm ahead of lead foot • 85cm hip peak
shots.proCoachTip: Tyson McGuffin: "Keep a near-vertical +2° face and brush +30° up the back of the ball (3h15➔2h30) to your shoulder for 1850 RPM dipping at the volleyer's hip."

shots.name: The Drip Hybrid Shot
shots.contactPoint: +28cm ahead of lead foot • 45–55cm low height
shots.proCoachTip: Rob Nunnery: "60-70% pace, 1550 RPM spin. Keep a +3° face tangent at 3h30 and brush +50° up the back (3h30➔2h30) to your shoulder so the ball dips at the kitchen volleyer's feet."

shots.name: Defensive Reset
shots.proCoachTip: Ben Johns: "Never swing at speed. Act like a +16° pillow (3/10 grip) absorbing 70% velocity, letting the ball die in the NVZ."

shots.name: Roll Volley
shots.paddleAngleAndPath: Slightly Open +4° (0°➔+6° at 3h15) • Vertical back-brush 3h15➔2h45 pulling up to shoulder (+42°)
shots.proCoachTip: Tyson McGuffin: "Drop the paddle below the ball (~4h00), contact at 3h15 (+4°), and use 85% shoulder lift to brush straight up the back (3h15➔2h45) to your shoulder — never chop over the 12h top!"

shots.name: Backhand & Forehand Wrist Flick
shots.proCoachTip: Tanner & Mari Humberg: "Never flick below the net! Disguise as a dink (3.5/10), intercept +45cm out in front at net height, and snap your wrist like an upside-down frisbee (<15cm) into their chicken wing."

shots.name: Punch Volley
shots.proCoachTip: Riley Newman: "Zero backswing. Lock your wrist (7/10) and punch flat (0° path, -4° face at 2h50) directly into open gaps."

shots.name: Scorpion Shot
shots.proCoachTip: Tyson McGuffin: "Squat low under the incoming drive, raise a -10° closed face (2h40) above your shoulder, and press -5° downward."

shots.name: The Tomahawk Shot
shots.proCoachTip: Zane Navratil: "Use a Continental grip, lead with a high elbow +34cm out front, and snap a -16° closed face downward to generate a filthy dipping angle!"

shots.name: Overhead Smash
shots.contactPoint: +32cm in front of forehead • 215–245cm peak reach
shots.proCoachTip: Federico Staksrud: "Turn sideways in Trophy Position, contact +32cm in front of your forehead, and snap a -20° closed face (2h20) down at -25°."

shots.name: Disguised Topspin Offensive Lob
shots.paddleAngleAndPath: Open +8° to +15° (Pro +10° • 3h30➔2h45) • +68° vertical lift to shoulder
shots.proCoachTip: Callie Smith: "Disguise your setup with a +10° Dink face (3h30), then explode upward (+68° brush 3h30➔2h45 to your shoulder) for 1400 RPM dropping inside the baseline."

shots.name: Aggressive Deep Serve
shots.paddleAngleAndPath: Slightly open 0° to +5° (Pro +3° • 3h15➔2h30) • +35° brush to shoulder (Rule 4.A.4)
shots.contactPoint: +40cm ahead of lead foot • 60–72cm below navel
shots.proCoachTip: Zane Navratil: "Strike below the navel with a slightly open +3° face at 3h15 and brush +35° upward (3h15➔2h30) to your shoulder for 1650 RPM dipping inside the baseline."

shots.name: Deep Return of Serve
shots.paddleAngleAndPath: Slightly open 0° to +6° (Pro +3° • 3h15➔2h30) • +28° brush to shoulder
shots.proCoachTip: Catherine Parenteau: "Redirect serve pace with a +3° face (3h15) and +28° lift (3h15➔2h30) to your shoulder for 1500 RPM deep to the server, using forward momentum to sprint to the Kitchen."

shots.name: Combo Drive-Drop Playbook
shots.paddleAngleAndPath: Shot 3 Drive (+2°) ➔ Open +8° to +14° (Pro +10° • 3h30➔2h50) on Shot 5
shots.proCoachTip: JW Johnson: "Blast a 3rd shot drive (+2°, 6/10), then split-step in midcourt, open your face to +10° (3h30), and lift +25° (3h30➔2h50, 850 RPM) for the 5th shot drop."

shots.name: Erne Shot
shots.proCoachTip: Tyler Loong: "Bait the sideline dink, leap outside the NVZ corner, and punch downward (-15° face at 2h30, -20° path) into the open court."

shots.name: Bert Shot
shots.proCoachTip: Ben Johns: "Strike at the apex of your jump with a -18° closed face (2h25) before your feet touch the ground outside the sideline."

shots.name: Around The Post (ATP)
shots.proCoachTip: Christian Alshon: "Let the ball drift past the post, keep the face at +2° (3h15), and brush +18° (3h15➔2h45) for 1150 RPM threading around the post inside the sideline."

tactics.name: Stacking & Switching Doubles Strategy
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Keeps both dominant forehands sealing 90% of the middle seam
tactics.tacticalSummary: Line up on the same side during serve/return and switch laterally to lock the middle with forehands.

tactics.name: Shake & Bake (3rd Shot Drive & 5th Shot Crash)
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Partner 1 fires dipping 3rd drive while Partner 2 crashes NVZ for 5th ball putaway
tactics.tacticalSummary: Aggressive two-player baseline-to-net blitz forcing a weak pop-up return on the 5th ball.

tactics.name: T1 & T2 Transition Zones Mastery
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Low-paddle short-hop at T1 ➔ Sprint past Dead Zone ➔ High-paddle counter at T2
tactics.tacticalSummary: 6-step midcourt quantization combining the 2-Step Shovel Push Protocol and shoulder-high out-ball discipline.

tactics.name: The Freezer (Target Isolation Strategy)
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Direct 85–90% of balls to weaker player outer sideline, starving the poacher
tactics.tacticalSummary: Psychologically and geometrically ice out the stronger opponent by isolating the weaker partner.

tactics.name: Anti-Smash Defensive Split-Step Wall
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Retreat 2 steps ➔ Land split-step 0.1s early ➔ 2.5/10 grip (COR 0.45)
tactics.tacticalSummary: Absorb 70% of incoming overhead smash kinetic energy and reset the ball softly back into the Kitchen.

tactics.name: Smart Speed-Up Combos & Counter Anticipation
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Initiate 1st speed-up jam ➔ Pre-aim for 85% predictable 2nd-ball rebound
tactics.tacticalSummary: Two-shot offensive patterns exploiting anatomical rebound angles at the Non-Volley Zone.

tactics.name: Chicken Wing Body-Jam Attack
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Target paddle-side armpit and hip (6in from torso) to jam elbow rotation
tactics.tacticalSummary: Mechanically lock the opponent paddle elbow in close-quarters 14ft kitchen exchanges.

tactics.name: Off-The-Bounce Banana Roll Curve
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Drop knees to net level ➔ Crescent brush 7-to-1 o-clock dipping at shoelaces
tactics.tacticalSummary: Curve aggressive topspin around the outer edge of a bouncing kitchen ball into opponent feet.

tactics.name: Aggressive Hip Push Dink
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Intercept bounce apex ➔ Linear +10° shoulder push deep into 1ft indecision zone
tactics.tacticalSummary: Disrupt passive dinking rhythms by driving linear pace deep into the opponent backhand hip.

tactics.name: Deep Slice Return & Net Sprint
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: Open +10°➔+18° slice buying 1.8–2.0s hangtime to complete 4-stride net rush
tactics.tacticalSummary: Float a deep penetrating slice return to buy full transition time to establish Kitchen dominance.

tactics.name: Breaking the 4.0 Barrier to 4.5+ (3-5-7-9 & Disguise)
tactics.coreBiomechanicalRule: 3-5-7-9 progression + 18–24in safety margin + NVZ disguise + Backhand counter
tactics.tacticalSummary: 5 tournament pillars eliminating rushed 4.0 habits to achieve consistent 4.5+ match dominance.
